test_title: PYST 56: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 11 Nov, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: Two trains start at the same time from two stations and travel towards each other with speeds of 72 km/h and 84 km/h, respectively. When they cross each other, it is found that one train has covered 108 km more than the other. What is the distance (in km) between the two stations, and after how many hours will they meet, respectively?
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of Train 1 = 72 km/h

Speed of Train 2 = 84 km/h

Distance covered by Train 2 is 108 km more than Train 1

**Formula used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

Relative Speed when traveling towards each other = Speed of Train 1 + Speed of Train 2

**Calculation:**

Let the time taken to meet be t hours.

Distance covered by Train 1 = 72 × t

Distance covered by Train 2 = 84 × t

Given, Distance covered by Train 2 - Distance covered by Train 1 = 108

⇒ 84 × t - 72 × t = 108

⇒ (84 - 72) × t = 108

⇒ 12 × t = 108

⇒ t = 108 / 12

⇒ t = 9 hours

Total distance between the two stations = Relative Speed × Time

Relative Speed = 72 + 84 = 156 km/h

⇒ Total Distance = 156 × 9

⇒ Total Distance = 1404 km

**∴ The correct answer is option (3): 1404 km; 9 hours.**
